# Practical Machinist

> The world's largest community forum and resource hub for machinists, CNC operators, and manufacturing professionals to share knowledge, techniques, and industry insights.

Practical Machinist serves the global manufacturing community through its flagship discussion forum, built on XenForo technology, and offers branded merchandise and tools for professionals in metalworking and industrial trades. The site supports multiple platforms including iOS and web applications.

## Key Topics

- Manufacturing Forum
- CNC Machining
- Metalworking
- G Code
- Community Discussion
- Industrial Technology
- Machinist Apparel
- XenForo Platform
- North American Manufacturing
- Branded Merchandise
- Web Applications
- iOS Apps
- Metal Fabrication
- Tool Discussions
- Industry Best Practices

## Community Forum

- [Practical Machinist - Largest Manufacturing Technology Forum](https://www.practicalmachinist.com/forum): World's largest machinist, CNC and manufacturing community forum for discussing techniques, projects, and industry knowledge

## Merchandise & Shop

- [Practical Machinist eShop - Practical Machinist](https://shop.practicalmachinist.com): Official Practical Machinist merchandise and branded apparel store offering machinist-themed clothing and gear
